sources.author: 赤潮最爱科先生
sources.limits: The article is community-authored. Numerical/qualitative fields below were read from the actual client screenshot, not attributed to an official prose guide. Screenshot build is unknown.

sources.fields: 6/12/18 armor, 8/10/12 seconds, ordinary attacks become area attacks; agrees with later card

localAdaptations.cleaveGeometry: primary plus Manhattan-one neighbours ordered by UID, including primary in the cap
localAdaptations.tauntGeometry: Manhattan distance at completed transformation only
localAdaptations.tauntBehavior: New ordinary attacks/pursuit are forced toward the living visible hostile caster and new active casts are denied for two seconds. Previously committed channels/projectiles continue; no repeated aura refresh.
localAdaptations.release: caster death/form expiry/invisibility or invalid allegiance, victim death/egg/soul/control immunity, duration expiry, or fish cleanse
localAdaptations.multipleSources: latest successfully completed transformation replaces the previous source; cleared sources do not revive older taunts
localAdaptations.statistics: count valid taunt applications, not forced attacks or productive control seconds

limits: Taunt range/duration and exact interaction rules are a disclosed local conversion; the card does not provide these numbers.
The card confirms the original target cap and taunt mechanic, not full historical AI/pathfinding/formula equivalence.
Ninja and monk remain prototypes in 0.57; future evidence is collected without silently changing their current abilities or costs.
The monk first damage digit needs independent readable evidence before implementation.
